==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Speak with [[Ceril Carnillean]] ({{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the house south-west of East Ardougne castle) {{Chat option|1What's wrong?|1Yes.}}
*Enter the [[Ardougne Sewers|Ardougne Sewers]] east of the [[clocktower]] (south of Valve 3)}}

[[File:Hazeel Cult - Quest map.png|676x676px]] 

Use this image as a reference for the following steps.

<tabber>

Side with Ceril=
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Clivet]] {{Chat option|2Alright, I've made my decision.|2I won't help you.}}
*Go back outside
*Turn Valve 1 '''RIGHT'''
*Turn Valve 2 '''RIGHT'''
*Turn Valve 3 '''LEFT'''
*Turn Valve 4 '''RIGHT'''
*Turn Valve 5 '''RIGHT'''
*Head back to cave, board the raft, and talk to [[Alomone]].
*Kill [[Alomone]] and loot the Carnillean armour from the chest.
** (Optional) If you want extra pieces of armour, multiple can be obtained using the [[drop trick]]. It can not be reobtained after the quest.
*Board the raft again and run back to the Carnilleans house.
*Talk to [[Ceril Carnillean]] (quest incomplete!)
*Search the [[cupboard (Hazeel Cult)|cupboard]] in the room upstairs east of the staircase to find the evidence.
}}
|-|
Side with Hazeel=
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Clivet]] to receive a bottle of [[poison]] {{Chat option|2Alright, I've made my decision.|1I'll help you.|1Alright, how do I do it?}}
*Turn Valve 1 '''RIGHT'''
*Turn Valve 2 '''RIGHT'''
*Go to the basement of the Carnilleans house (ladder)
*Use the bottle of [[poison]] on the cooking range.
*Talk to Ceril on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.
*Talk to Clivet.
*Turn Valve 3 '''LEFT'''
*Turn Valve 4 '''RIGHT'''
*Turn Valve 5 '''RIGHT'''
*Go back to the cave and board the raft.
*Talk to [[Alomone]].
*Go back to the Carnilleans' house.
*Talk to [[Butler Jones]].
*Go in the basement and search the [[crate (Hazeel Cult)|crate]] for a Chest key.
*Go up the ladder and stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, and go up the ladder.
*Unlock and search the chest to find [[Hazeel scroll|the scroll]].
*Return to Alomone.
}}
</tabber>{{Checklist|*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
